scheduleO.narrative: Kansas City Woodworkers Guild Inc (KCWG) is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit corporation formed in 1992 in Missouri. The Guild's mission is to promote the art and craft of woodworking through education, community engagement, and shared access to tools and facilities. KCWG supports members of all skill levels through classes, workshops, monthly meetings, special interest groups (SIGs), and collaborative projects including Rough to Ready, Basic Woodworking, Intermediate Woodworking, Bandsaw Box, Intro to Hand Tool Woodworking, and specialty SIGs covering CNC, Hand Tool, Carving, Finishing, and Laser Engraving.

scheduleO.partAndLine: Part XI Line 8 — Prior Period Adjustment
scheduleO.narrative: The QuickBooks balance sheet reflects an Opening Balance Equity of $5,000.00 as of the beginning of the 2025 tax year. This amount represents the initial capitalization of the organization's QuickBooks accounting system and does not correspond to revenue or expense activity recorded during the 2025 tax year. Because beginning-of-year net assets are reported as $0.00 (no prior-year comparative QuickBooks data is available) and ending net assets are $5,000.00, and because total revenue of $260.00 less total expenses of $0.00 yields a current-year change of $260.00, the difference of $4,740.00 ($5,000.00 ending net assets minus $0.00 beginning net assets minus $260.00 current-year change) is reported on Part XI, line 8 as a prior period adjustment attributable to the Opening Balance Equity entry. Preparer should confirm the nature and timing of the $5,000.00 Opening Balance Equity and whether any portion represents prior-year retained earnings or initial contributed capital requiring reclassification.
